page.overview:
Who is Aigorn?

Aigorn was a female Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, she tasked a spacer with eliminating one of the medical staff from the White Thranta Shipping Company and steal medical data from the White Thranta bunker.

Aigorn appears in the directory tree files for the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, According to these files, introduced with the 2005 "New Game Enhancements," Aigorn would have been a quest giver, giving to players two quests named "Opening Moves" and "Information Control" during the Mos Eisley part of the "Legacy Quest." However, Aigorn is not known to have appeared on the game's live servers as a proper non-player character. Nevertheless, an emulated depiction pulled from this character's Interchange File Format reveals what he would have looked like if he were added to the game.
